summary: Improve market prioritization, opportunity qualification and pipeline reviews with practical business development training. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Business development is the work of identifying viable revenue opportunities and deciding how to pursue them. This training is for professionals who assess markets, qualify prospects, develop accounts or support commercial growth decisions. It covers market prioritisation and opportunity qualification, account planning and value proposition design, and pipeline review using stages and KPIs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess markets, qualify prospects, develop accounts or support commercial growth decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with customer-facing work, sales pipelines or commercial planning will help you apply the exercises. Coding or programming is not required.
